selected.title: UK competition watchdog raises concerns over Brink's-NCR Atleos deal
selected.summary: The UK's competition watchdog says it will undertake an in-depth investigation into cash management giant Brink's' planned $6.6 billion deal to buy ATM operator NCR Atleos - unless the parties take action to address concerns.
selected.why: UK CMA threatens in-depth probe into $6.6B Brink's-NCR Atleos merger.

reason: CMA's Brink's-NCR Atleos probe raises genuine debate about whether cash infrastructure consolidation harms competition or enables necessary modernisation
angle: Cash industry consolidation may reduce competition but could paradoxically strengthen resilience and innovation in payment infrastructure Britain depends on.
